proposals.current_guidance: Open with the single most specific measured fact about THEIR support surface. State it plainly, say where it came from so they can check it in ten minutes, and ask whether it matches their internal picture. No pitch, no product mention, no meeting request.
proposals.proposed_guidance: Open with the single most specific measured fact about THEIR support surface, and quote the number exactly as the brief states it: same figure, same unit, same form. If the brief says a percentage, write the percentage. Never convert it into a count, ratio, "1 in N," or time total, and never round, combine, or extrapolate it (for example, don't turn "18% of tickets" into "about 900 tickets"). Say where the number came from so they can check it in ten minutes, and ask whether it matches their internal picture. No pitch, no product mention, no meeting request. If the brief offers only a figure you'd need to transform to make the point land, use a different measured fact the brief already states in usable form.

proposals.current_guidance: Open with a single verbatim customer quote from their own public reviews, then one sentence on what makes that CLASS of complaint different from product complaints. Shortest possible message. The quote does the work; do not explain it twice.
proposals.proposed_guidance: Open with a single verbatim customer quote from their own public reviews, then one sentence on what makes that CLASS of complaint different from product complaints. That sentence must be a usable diagnostic, not a gesture: state what this type of complaint tells them to check or do (for example, "this kind of complaint usually points to a handoff failing between X and Y, not a feature gap, so it won't show up in your roadmap data"), so the recipient walks away with a reframe they can act on even if they never reply. Don't pitch, don't ask for a call as the only payload, and don't just restate the quote's sentiment. Keep it short, but make sure the one sentence after the quote contains something they didn't already know.
